title: authenticate
description: Comprehensive coverage of Triauth.authenticate: Stage 1 (request) validation, DNS, and success paths; Stage 3 (verify) positive and negative paths. Stage 3 positives carry recorded signatures (es256 and ed25519) minted once by test/fixtures/json/_capture_auth.mjs — WebCrypto ECDSA is non-deterministic to mint and deterministic to verify, Ed25519 is deterministic both ways; hand-written cases extend the suite alongside the captured ones.
